title: O Trinity of Blessed Light
alsoKnownAs: Thou Who Art Three in Unity
description: O Trinity of Blessed Light in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Ambrose of Milan, first published in 400. The English translation is by John Mason Neale (1852). The tune, O LUX BEATA TRINITAS, is Traditional Latin. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: O_ Trin___-i-ty of bless_-èd_ light, O_ U___-ni-ty of prince_-ly_ might, The_ fie-ry_ sun now_ goes_ his__ way; Shed_ Thou___ with-in our hearts_ a_ ray.

lines: The fiery sun now goes his way;
Shed Thou within our hearts a ray.
To Thee our morning song of praise,
To Thee our evening prayer we raise;
O grant us with Thy saints on high
All laud to God the Father be,
All praise, eternal Son, to Thee,
All glory, as is ever meet,

reviewNotes: Held back: the score has no time signature (a chant or free rhythm), which the solfa grid cannot bar; bar 1 has 7.5 beats, more than 4; bar 2 has 7.5 beats, more than 4; bar 3 has 7.5 beats, more than 4; bar 4 has 7.5 beats, more than 4.
